name: Nazi Germany
facts: Germany, Austria and parts of Poland and Russia

flag.description: A red field with a white disc, set slightly towards the hoist, bearing a black swastika turned at 45 degrees.
flag.symbolism: It was the flag of the Nazi Party; Hitler wrote that red stood for the movement's social idea, white for its nationalism and the swastika for its racist ideology of "Aryan" supremacy.

hook: This was the flag of the Nazi dictatorship, which started the Second World War in Europe and carried out the Holocaust, the murder of six million Jews.
trivia: It became the sole national flag under the Reich Flag Law of September 1935, one of the Nuremberg Laws.
Displaying the swastika flag is a criminal offence in Germany, with exceptions for purposes such as education, research and art.
